<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Court" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="L1" name="Mail Clerk">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>collect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>sort</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>distribute</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="L2" name="Registry">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>open</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>register</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="L3" name="Assistant Registry Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>compliant</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>compile</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>sendback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>capture</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>envelope</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>post</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>done</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="L4" name="Cashier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>fees</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>party</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>print</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Day starts" />
    <bpmn:task id="collect" name="Collect the mail from the party" />
    <bpmn:task id="sort" name="Sort the unopened mail into business areas" />
    <bpmn:task id="distribute" name="Distribute the mail" />
    <bpmn:task id="open" name="Open and sort the mail into groups" />
    <bpmn:task id="register" name="Register the mail in the incoming Mail Register" />
    <bpmn:task id="check" name="Perform the quality check" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="compliant" name="Mail compliant?" />
    <bpmn:task id="compile" name="Compile the list of requisition" />
    <bpmn:task id="sendback" name="Send the list back to the party" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="rejected" name="Mail rejected" />
    <bpmn:task id="capture" name="Capture the matter details" />
    <bpmn:task id="fees" name="Take the applicable fees" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="split" />
    <bpmn:task id="envelope" name="Put the receipt and copied documents into an envelope" />
    <bpmn:task id="post" name="Post the envelope to the party" />
    <bpmn:task id="party" name="Capture the Party Details" />
    <bpmn:task id="print" name="Print the Physical Court File" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="join" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="done" name="Mail processed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="collect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="collect" targetRef="sort" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="sort" targetRef="distribute" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="sendback" targetRef="rejected" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="fees" targetRef="split" />
